characters.name: 许星然
characters.design: 27-year-old Chinese woman with low black ponytail, faint dark circles under eyes but sharp bright gaze, wearing dark grey wool coat with black lanyard holding work ID, realistic gritty style, cool underlighting on her face, full body side shot to show her holding the notebook in the empty carriage environment.

characters.name: 地铁值班员
characters.design: 55-year-old Chinese man with graying temples, wearing navy blue subway uniform and matching peaked cap, holding a black walkie-talkie in hand, realistic slice-of-life style, dim station ambient light on his face, front medium shot to show his calm expression when facing Xu Xingran on the platform.

props.name: 遗落日记本
props.design: Thick paperback notebook with slightly worn cover, first page has handwritten text 'To whoever finds this' in black ink, paper has faint creases from being carried, realistic paper texture, close-up shot to highlight the handwritten text on the first page.

props.name: 员工工牌挂绳
props.design: Black woven lanyard with small white company logo, hanging a rectangular white work ID with Xu Xingran's photo and position, worn fabric texture, chest close-up shot to show the lanyard details when she moves in the carriage.

props.name: 值班对讲机
props.design: Standard black plastic subway staff walkie-talkie with short antenna, slight surface scratches from daily use, held in the station staff's hand, medium close-up shot to clearly show the device and his hand gripping it.

scenes.name: 空荡末班地铁车厢
scenes.design: Realistic late-night subway carriage with rows of bright orange empty seats, flickering cool tunnel lights passing through the windows, dim station sign glow on the ceiling, desaturated cool color grade with boosted orange accents, wide shot to show the empty lonely carriage environment.

scenes.name: 深夜地铁站台
scenes.design: Empty late-night subway platform with dim digital station display lights, cool underlighting from platform edge lights, grey concrete floor with faint wet marks, realistic gritty urban style, medium wide shot to show the space where Xu Xingran faces the station staff.

scenes.name: 地铁隧道窗外
scenes.design: Dark enclosed subway tunnel with fast-flickering passing tunnel lights reflected on the carriage window, occasional light streaks from passing trains, low-key ambient lighting, close-up shot of the window to show the dynamic flickering light effect.
